scenes.scene: Only one person in the room: SIL alone peeks back in through the half-open bedroom door, one hand on the door frame, with a mysterious little smile; the room is empty, the bed visible on the side, in a small guest bedroom of a modest Moroccan apartment in the evening, single bed with a patterned blanket, a zellige tile strip on the wall, a wooden door, warm lamp light. Main characters fully visible in the centre, calm background at the edges, 2D cartoon comedy style, no text
